patch_description: This constructor replaces the fixed ring layout with a multistart nonlinear packing optimizer. It jointly adjusts all circle centers and radii using constrained SLSQP optimization, starting from a dense 5-by-5 grid plus an additional circle in an interior gap. For every candidate set of centers, a linear program recomputes the best valid radii exactly for those locations. This hybrid approach combines geometric nonlinear repositioning with globally optimal radius assignment for fixed centers, while a final safety contraction guarantees that all circles remain inside the unit square and non-overlapping.
